title: Logger
description: Used for printing custom messages to the logger.

id.title: Id
id.description: Sets the id of this node

note.title: Note
note.description: Sets the note of this node

description.title: Description
description.description: Sets the description of this node

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Disables this EIP from the route.

message.title: Message
message.description: Sets the log message (uses simple language)

loggingLevel.title: Logging Level
loggingLevel.description: Sets the logging level. The default value is INFO

logName.title: Log Name
logName.description: Sets the name of the logger. The name is default the routeId or the source:line if source location is enabled. You can also specify the name using tokens: ${class} - the logger class name (org.apache.camel.processor.LogProcessor) ${contextId} - the camel context id ${routeId} - the route id ${groupId} - the route group id ${nodeId} - the node id ${nodePrefixId} - the node prefix id ${source} - the source:line (source location must be enabled) ${source.name} - the source filename (source location must be enabled) ${source.line} - the source line number (source location must be enabled) For example to use the route and node id you can specify the name as: ${routeId}/${nodeId}

logger.title: Logger
logger.description: To refer to a custom logger instance to lookup from the registry.

logLanguage.title: Log Language
logLanguage.description: To configure the language to use. By default, the simple language is used. However, Camel also supports other languages such as groovy.
